**Verdict: don't publish as written.** One claim is wrong, and one sentence repeats another.

**Claims check**

| Claim in draft | Status |
|---|---|
| "Loose leaf tea" | Product fact, fine |
| "packed by hand in Bristol" / "Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" | Allowlisted (Operations) |
| "certified organic by the Soil Association" | Allowlisted (certificate renewed 2026) |
| "Free UK delivery on all orders" | **Unsupported.** The allowlist says free UK delivery on orders **over £25**. "All orders" promises something the shipping policy doesn't. |

**Other points**
- The first sentence and the second say the same thing about hand packing in Bristol. Keep one.
- There are no banned words, no health, green or superlative claims, no fake urgency, and no disclosure is needed for our own landing page.
- Sam still needs to approve it before it goes live.

**Suggested rewrite**

> Loose leaf tea, packed by hand in Bristol. Every tin is certified organic by the Soil Association. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

One caution: "Every tin is certified organic" is slightly broader than the allowlisted wording. To stay exact, use "Our tea is certified organic by the Soil Association", as in the original.
